statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Diagnosis codes I47.1 and I25.10 were submitted
The denial reason code is CO-197
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
